full_judgment: The appellant as the pre-emptor filed Miscellaneous Case No.02 of 2002 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Rangunia, Chittagong for pre-emption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act-1950 in respect of the land transferred by the respondent Nos.5-10 in favour of respondent Nos.2-4 by a sale deed No.3326 registered on 17-10-2001 in the sub-registry office at Rangunia, Chittagong.
